_about: OmegaWeapon grading constants. Every grade on the dashboard is computed by scripts/omega_metrics.py from these values and the manifest; nothing is typed by hand. The Method tab prints this file so a reader can see how a grade was made. A grade never rests on unverified evidence alone: unverified rows lower confidence, never the grade.

density_bands._about: weighted defect score divided by pages (or listings, apps, campaigns) assessed; the band gives the letter

confidence_bands._about: share of a pillar's evidence weight that is observed (fetched, measured, exported, screenshot)

exposure_grade._about: Compliance & Exposure is graded from dispositions, not density

market_grade._about: Market Position is graded from the Moon eye: complaint share (intent C over counted floor items) and mean floor stance

agency_fit_grade._about: Agency Fit is graded from inherited findings (template defects the agency of record shipped) as a share of all High and Medium findings, plus claims-screen rows

honest_count_rules.routable: disposition CONFIRMED, confidence Confirmed, route not NONE and not PRIVATE
confirmed_needs: cite_fetched date present or a vintage flag

forbidden_terms._about: strings the validator refuses in any client-facing field: vendor authority scores and guarantees

momentum._about: measured against the previous run of the same target in the same cache folder: grade letter delta, findings resolved and new, exposure count deltas, brand stereopsis share deltas with two-proportion z
